description:
Application for a non-material amendment to planning permission Ref: P0615.21 dated 06/09/2023 to replace an approved drawing number (AL) 10 A 00 10 Rv.01 (Temporary access and service routes for detailed area) with drawing number RVG-ATP-A-02-DR-A-10020 Rev 1 (Temporary Access and Service Routes for Detailed Area ) to vary condition 4 (Hybrid planning application for phased mixed-use development for the provision of seven blocks (Block A to G) of 2 to 12 storeys to include up to 972 residential units comprising:

Full application (Block A) for a total of 146 residential units (Class C3), retail/restaurant unit (Class E), medical or neighbourhood centre (Class E(e), F2); energy centre (sui generis); parking, access from the southern roundabout and temporary road access arrangements.

Outline application for site preparation for erection of six blocks (Blocks B to G) of up to 826 residential units (Classes C3) including up to 223 later living/extra care/residential units (Classes C2/C3); medical/hospital facility (Class C2/E(e)), flexible retail and cafe space (Class E), gym facilities for residents and NHS Staff (Class E), Medical/neighbourhood centre (Class Ee/F2); energy centre, basement, associated landscaping, car parking, refuse storage and other associated works with all matters
reserved.
decision_conditions: The amendment to the approved application listed below is considered to be of a minor nature and acceptable in its own right and not require resubmission of a fresh planning application.
The following amendment is deemed to be accepted:

- Amendments to replace an approved drawing number (AL) 10 A 00 10 Rv.01 (Temporary access and service routes for detailed area) with drawing number RVG-ATP-A-02-DR-A-10020 Rev 1 (Temporary Access and Service Routes for Detailed Area).
Furthermore, this amendment does not in any way alter or remove any previous conditions imposed on the original approved application reference P0615.21.
The applicant is advised that this amendment relates solely to the item detailed above and shown on drawing numbers
1.	RVG-ATP-A-02-DR-A-10020 Rev 1 (Temporary Access and Service Routes for Detailed Area);
2.	Covering Letter dated, 3 December 2024 and 17 June 2025;
and not to any other deviation from the approved drawings.
Furthermore, this amendment does not in any way alter or remove any previous conditions imposed on the original approved application reference P0615.21.
